text: I don't know. Attendance for the earliest games in the Syracuse-Colgate series (which dates to the 1890s) was often unrecorded or only loosely reported in newspapers, so I can't give a figure without fabricating one. Syracuse's football media guide or record book, or digitized period newspapers such as the *Syracuse Daily Standard* via Fultonhistory.com, are the most likely places to find it, if it was recorded at all.
